<!-- ClipLink is a reactive service: uploads are NOT scanned. This template is
     the official channel for abuse reports, takedown requests (including
     copyright/DMCA-style notices), grant-of-privacy requests, and grievances
     under India's IT Rules, 2021. Target: acknowledgement within 24 h,
     action within 72 h. Prefer e-mail for sensitive/urgent matters:
     sayyidsajada4s@gmail.com — do NOT include personal data of victims here. -->

> E-mail alternative: **sayyidsajada4s@gmail.com**

**Report type** (choose one):
- [ ] Illegal content (explain the law broken)
- [ ] Malware / phishing / fraud
- [ ] Child safety (CSAM/CSII) — urgent
- [ ] Copyright / DMCA-style notice
- [ ] Privacy / data-protection request (access / erasure / objection)
- [ ] Grievance under India IT Rules 2021
- [ ] Non-consensual intimate imagery / harassment

**Share link (token or URL):**
<!-- REQUIRED for takedowns. Example: https://api.cliplink.workers.dev/s/AbCdEf123 -->

**Description of the problem:**
<!-- What law/right is being violated; how you found it; any deadline/dates. -->

**For copyright notices, confirm all six elements of a valid notice:**
- [ ] Identification of the copyrighted work
- [ ] URL/token of the infringing material (above)
- [ ] Your contact information (put minimal contact info, NOT a full address)
- [ ] Good-faith belief statement
- [ ] Statement, under penalty of perjury, that the info is accurate and you are authorised to act
- [ ] Signature (typing your name counts)

**Your contact (reply channel only):**
<!-- An e-mail you actually monitor, or "respond in this issue". -->
